experience.title: Private sauna and steam bath
experience.text: In our apartment in Livigno, Italy, the private sauna and steam bath are never shared with other guests. After a day of skiing in the Italian Alps, come home to warmth that's entirely yours — let the day melt away before dinner.
experience.point_1_text: Deep heat therapy, ideal for muscle recovery after skiing.
experience.point_2_text: Warm steam all to yourselves, no waiting, no sharing.
experience.point_3_text: The cozy warmth of an electric fireplace in the living room, for family evenings.

rooms.room1_text: Two single beds joined by a topper, for the comfort of a real double bed — ideal for the couple or the group's parents.
rooms.room2_text: Two single beds, combinable on request into a double bed.
rooms.room3_text: Double bed with a topper for maximum comfort — the apartment's main bedroom.

reviews.title: In our guests' words
reviews.quote1: The most beautifully appointed chalet we have ever stayed in. Our hosts were exceptional and our every possible need was met.
reviews.quote2: Sicuramente il miglior alloggio Airbnb in cui abbiamo soggiornato. La casa è estremamente ben costruita e l'host si prende molta cura di renderla un soggiorno perfetto. La posizione è perfetta per accedere a tutto ciò che Livigno ha da offrire.
reviews.quote3: Il nostro soggiorno nell'appartamento è stato eccellente: cucina ben attrezzata, bagno turco e una rilassante sauna a infrarossi. Consigliamo vivamente questo posto meraviglioso e i suoi host eccezionali.
reviews.quote4: Excellent apartment in an excellent location. Very nice hosts.
reviews.quote5: Tutto perfetto! Il proprietario è molto gentile e disponibile. L'appartamento è lussuoso e in zona perfetta: mercato, bar, noleggio sci e stazione bus di fronte.
reviews.quote6: Francesco e la sua famiglia hanno costruito senza dubbio l'alloggio più bello in cui abbiamo soggiornato, con un livello di lusso a cui non siamo abituati. È impossibile trovare difetti nell'appartamento.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.q1_q: Are the sauna and steam bath private?
faq.q1_a: Yes, our vacation rental apartment in Livigno, Italy offers an infrared sauna and steam bath for the exclusive use of the apartment's guests, never shared with others.
faq.q2_q: How far is it from the ski lifts?
faq.q2_a: Our apartment in Livigno, Italy is just 100 meters on foot from the ski lifts. The ski school and equipment rental are 50 meters away.
faq.q3_q: Is it suitable for families with young children?
faq.q3_a: Yes, our apartment in Livigno is designed specifically for families with children: a crib and high chair are available on request, and the space comfortably hosts families and groups of up to 6.
faq.q4_q: Is there storage for skis and bikes?
faq.q4_a: Yes, the apartment has dedicated storage for skis, boots, and bikes.
faq.q5_q: What are check-in and check-out times?
faq.q5_a: Times are confirmed at booking via WhatsApp, with flexibility depending on availability.
faq.q6_a: Fill in the request form above or message us directly on WhatsApp at +39 0342 929285: we'll reply with availability and a quote.
faq.q7_a: Yes, on request, and it's a paid service: €15.00 per person per day of use, at a partner venue about 50 meters from the apartment. Must be booked in advance; payment is made on-site.
faq.q8_a: Yes, 2 electric bikes are available for rent on-site at €35.00 per person per day, on request and for a fee. Must be booked in advance; payment is made on-site.
faq.q9_a: Yes, the apartment includes a free parking space.
faq.q10_a: No, the apartment does not accept pets.
faq.q11_a: Yes, generally 2-3 nights, with possible changes during peak season. Message us on WhatsApp for details on your specific dates.
faq.q12_a: Cancellation includes a partial refund if made by a certain deadline before arrival. For the exact details based on your booking, contact us on WhatsApp at +39 0342 929285.
faq.q13_q: Is the apartment close to downtown Livigno?
faq.q13_a: Yes, our apartment in Livigno, Italy is just a 15-minute walk from the town center, in a quiet, strategic area, close to the ski lifts and the cross-country ski trail.

summer.title: Livigno, Italy is just as stunning in summer
summer.text: Hiking trails, mountain biking across the peaks, the Lake of Livigno and blooming alpine pastures: the same strategic location that makes winter perfect becomes, in summer, the ideal base for exploring the Italian Alps.
summer.ebike_note: 2 electric bikes available for rent directly on-site at €35.00 per person per day, on request and to be booked in advance (payment on-site), to explore the trails around Livigno.
